working_on.task: Optimize login page UI layout for mobile devices
working_on.notes: Added media query styles for .auth-page and .auth-card to fit smaller viewport widths, adjusted Google Sign-in button sizing to dynamically compute responsive width preventing overflow.

recent_changes.description: Optimized Login UI screen to render correctly on mobile screens by reducing card padding and dynamic resizing of Google Sign-In wrapper.
Fixed Google Login 422 error by changing 'credential' to 'token' in schema. Implemented TTL cleanup job (30 days) for local audio files and updated frontend UI to show expiration countdown badges.
Created ecosystem.config.js for PM2 configuration, updated Nginx reverse proxy configuration, added /health check endpoint, and increased concurrent request limits.
Implemented get_worker_stats helper on QueueManager to return dynamic system and user-specific worker capacities.

errors_encountered.error: Google login failed with 422 Unprocessable Content
errors_encountered.solution: Changed 'credential' to 'token' in GoogleLoginRequest schema (backend/schemas.py) and auth router to match frontend payload.

errors_encountered.error: Lỗi đường dẫn API bị nhân đôi thành /api/api/auth/login khi chạy Nginx reverse proxy
errors_encountered.solution: Bỏ dấu gạch chéo '/' ở cuối địa chỉ proxy_pass trong cấu hình Nginx (proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000;)

errors_encountered.error: NameError: name models is not defined
errors_encountered.solution: Thêm import models vào các file routers
